note: Curated from the passive trees, re-checked 2026-08-18 against the PathofDust Rust source (passive-tree.json is generated from src/passive_tree.rs). Numbers quote max-rank values. Point budget: 1 + floor(level/4) (passive_tree.rs points_for_level) — 23 points at level 88, 30 at 119. Skills cost 3, specializations 4 (the 4th point reveals modifiers but does not grow the spec's own stat), modifiers 3. Gear no longer rolls Healing Power: that affix was reworked into Lingering Effect on 2026-08-15, and heal power now comes only from archetype, passive tree, and the Divine Damage self-buff loop.

builds.name: Titan's Fortress
builds.tagline: Defense converted three ways into multiplicative damage
builds.why: Three conversion engines: Titan's Grip turns the doubled Juggernaut HP (48%) into MULTIPLICATIVE damage, Unbreakable turns block overflow past 75% into damage, Overwhelming Force converts damage reduction into more damage. Tank stats, top-of-meter output.

rolls.why: Feeds Unbreakable's overflow — gear counts toward the 75% cap, and the rest becomes damage. Stack to ~150% total, then pivot: Unbreakable's channel saturates there and further block only pays the small baseline conversion
Multiplies with Titan's Grip's multiplicative bonus
NOT a rollable mod — attack speed exists only as the gloves' primary stat (0.9%/tier, source default). Chase higher-tier gloves instead of rolling for it. (More swings through the converted damage)
Overwhelming Force converts 30% of it into damage — defense that attacks. Useful to ~150% total; past that the conversion channel is saturated and only the baseline overflow pays
LAST for damage: Titan's Grip explicitly ignores gear HP — roll it for survival only

builds.name: Culling Chain
builds.tagline: Four-strike Frenzy procs that chain and execute
builds.why: Frenzy 3/3 strikes four times per proc at ~40% chance (Rising Fury + Frenzied Assault), doubled to ~80% vs enemies ≤65% HP by Blood Scent. Chain Frenzy re-rolls up to 3 extra procs; every strike executes at ≤6% HP via Culling Strike.

rolls.why: NOT a rollable mod — attack speed exists only as the gloves' primary stat (0.9%/tier, source default). Chase higher-tier gloves instead of rolling for it. (Every hit is a Frenzy roll — attack speed multiplies the whole engine)
Scales all four strikes and every chain
Frenzy strikes crit like any hit
Survival — Bloodletting covers it in-tree only if you detour

builds.name: Overflow Assassin
builds.tagline: Evasion past the cap becomes crit; crits duplicate themselves
builds.why: Elusive + Phantom double-convert evasion overflow into up to +60% crit chance for wearing defensive gear. Every crit has 75% (Flurry) to Twin Strike; Duskveil adds +30% attack speed from the same overflow. Double Tap (now capped at 9 chains) is the first flex point past 23.

rolls.why: The whole build — every % past 75 double-converts to crit (and attack speed). Roll it on every slot up to ~400% total; there Elusive/Phantom/Duskveil all saturate and extra evasion only pays the baseline conversion
Crit chance comes free from the conversion; damage multiplies it
NOT a rollable mod — attack speed exists only as the gloves' primary stat (0.9%/tier, source default). Chase higher-tier gloves instead of rolling for it. (More hits, more crits, more Twin Strikes)
Generic scaling after the engine is online

builds.name: Stone Current
builds.tagline: Overcapped evasion turned into damage, HP and stacking crit
builds.why: Stone Fist + Granite Skin double-convert evasion overflow into up to +60% damage; Earthen Will (first flex point) adds max HP from the same stat. Flowing Strikes + Pressure Point turn hit cadence into stacking crit with +30% crit damage from Nerve Strike.

rolls.why: One stat feeds offense (Stone Fist + Granite Skin), defense, and Meditation sustain. Stack to ~300% total, then pivot — the conversion channels cap at +10%/rank and are full there
NOT a rollable mod — attack speed exists only as the gloves' primary stat (0.9%/tier, source default). Chase higher-tier gloves instead of rolling for it. (Builds and holds Flowing Strikes stacks)
Pressure Point supplies the crit chance; multiply it

builds.name: Burning Chapel
builds.tagline: Every heal is also an AoE nuke
builds.why: Radiant Smite heals allies for up to 45% of your max HP per hit (Zealotry), and Holy Fire converts 45% of ALL healing done into damage on every enemy, striking 3 extra times with Rising Blaze. Healing power multiplies both halves at once. Divine Shield + Guardian's Oath round out party defense; Aegis Ward is the flex path past 23.

rolls.why: Gear stopped granting Healing Power entirely (the affix was reworked into Lingering Effect on 2026-08-15) — Divine Damage is the replacement lever: every heal you land rolls floor(divine%) GUARANTEED self-buff stacks, 1% heal power each for 4s, uncapped, and the roll is flat increased damage on top. Weapon/helm only
Radiant Smite and Divine Shield both scale off YOUR max HP
Past 50% it overflow-converts to damage reduction via Aegis Ward (flex path). Useful to ~250% total — Aegis Ward saturates there
Radiant Smite reaches more allies to heal per hit

builds.name: Arrowstorm
builds.tagline: Splash is a double damage multiplier now
builds.why: Volley grants +30% damage per REACHABLE target, and reworked Chain Shot adds another +30% per rank to that same per-target bonus for the whole attack — gear splash multiplies damage twice. Storm of Arrows guarantees 3 extra targets; Piercing Shots lets all of it crit independently.

rolls.why: Reach = damage: Volley + Chain Shot pay +60%/target at max ranks. The build's core stat
Piercing Shots (flex path) makes splash crit with your full multiplier
Multiplies the independent splash crits
NOT a rollable mod — attack speed exists only as the gloves' primary stat (0.9%/tier, source default). Chase higher-tier gloves instead of rolling for it. (More volleys)

builds.name: Infinite Echo
builds.tagline: Crits that recast themselves up to nine times
builds.why: Spell Echo recasts crits at 75% chance (Resonance) for 80% damage (Echoing Power), chaining nine deep via Finite Loop. Crit CHANCE fuels the loop's frequency — Critical Mass + Mana Surge supply +21% on top of gear. The 22% crit-damage root multiplies every echo. Overload/Cataclysm are the flex path past 23.

rolls.why: Every point multiplies echo frequency — the loop lives on it
Stacks with the root's 22% and Arcane Mastery on every echo

NOT a rollable mod — attack speed exists only as the gloves' primary stat (0.9%/tier, source default). Chase higher-tier gloves instead of rolling for it. (More base casts to start chains; enables Temporal Rift flex past 100%)
Volatile Magic (flex) splashes echo crits

builds.name: Doomstack
builds.tagline: +68% damage taken for the whole party, then it detonates
builds.why: The curse stack (20+24+24%) makes every party member hit 68% harder on cursed targets. Doom replays 105% of everything dealt to the target as a detonation, splashing at 90% via Apocalypse. Dark Pact leans into the 16% attack-speed root; Unstable Power (flex) converts speed past 100% into damage.

rolls.why: NOT a rollable mod — attack speed exists only as the gloves' primary stat (0.9%/tier, source default). Chase higher-tier gloves instead of rolling for it. (Root synergy now, Unstable Power conversion past 100% later — never wasted)
Everything you deal gets replayed by Doom at 105%
Crits feed the Doom bank too
Soul Siphon path covers sustain if you flex there instead

builds.name: Unkillable Choir
builds.tagline: Two death-saves a fight and shields made of overheal
builds.why: Guardian Spirit prevents ANY party death twice per fight. Divine Grace + Radiant Light + Luminous stack ~150% healing power in three independent channels, making Overflowing Grace bank overheal into shields; Balanced Faith (2/3 at the 23-point line) adds damage reduction while shielded.

rolls.why: Gear no longer rolls Healing Power at all (retired 2026-08-15) — Divine Damage feeds the self-buff loop instead: floor(divine%) guaranteed 1%-heal-power stacks per heal, uncapped, which drives heal power past 100% and divides your action interval down to the 50ms floor. Weapon/helm only
Blessed Resilience scales the party off it; you must survive to save others
Sanctified Touch (flex path) turns heal crits into +80% heals
Soak redirected hits for the party — hard-capped at 50% with no overflow channel in this tree, so one good roll is enough

builds.name: Evergrowth Engine
builds.tagline: Healing power that compounds into action speed, DoT heals and shields
builds.why: Regrowth and Blooming Field are separate MULTIPLICATIVE ×1.3 healing multipliers. Evergrowth turns 9% of total healing power into Lingering Effect and Seed of Life turns every tick into shields; healing power past 100% already shortens your action interval on its own. Nature's Blessing + Bloom Strike add +60% crit chance for heal-crits. (Wild Surge/Overgrowth are still inactive — banked points, avoid for now.)

rolls.why: Gear Healing Power is gone (retired 2026-08-15); Divine Damage is how you buy it now — floor(divine%) guaranteed self-buff stacks per heal, uncapped. That heal power then feeds Evergrowth (9% of it becomes Lingering Effect at 3/3) and divides your interval to the 50ms floor. Weapon/helm only
Stacks with Evergrowth's conversion; Seed of Life shields every tick
Root synergy; Shifting Form flex path double-converts overflow — useful to ~300% total, then the channel saturates

builds.name: Uncapped Exsanguinator
builds.tagline: 80% damage replay, no leech cap, quadruple hits every few seconds
builds.why: Hemorrhage explodes 5-stack wounds for 80% of all damage dealt to the target; its Overflow leech bypasses the leech cap, which Endless Thirst removes entirely during FlickerStrike anyway. Bloodpact fires quadruple-damage hits on a cooldown; Blood Debt (8 stacks) and Blood Sacrifice are the flex path past 23.

rolls.why: Hemorrhage replays 80% of everything — damage is also your healing

NOT a rollable mod — attack speed exists only as the gloves' primary stat (0.9%/tier, source default). Chase higher-tier gloves instead of rolling for it. (Faster wound stacking, more FlickerStrike value)
Crits inflate the Hemorrhage bank
Pairs with crit damage into the bank

builds.name: Golem Vanguard
builds.tagline: A summoned wall that eats the party's damage; elemental procs scale with level
builds.why: Ranged splash caster with NO baseline healing — all of it is earned in the tree. Elemental Focus adds 5% additive lightning/cold/fire damage per character level, and Scorching Flames stacks another 10%/level of fire on top. Golem Master summons up to 3 golems; Thunder Golem absorbs all externally-sourced party damage until it dies, then redistributes 50% of what it ate as a short party DoT. Healing Flames is the only self-sustain (up to 10% HP/sec). Almost all of this is per-fight simulation the closed-form advisor cannot score, so its rank here understates the class — treat the golem and proc kit as upside.

rolls.why: Righteous Fire and golem attacks hit more targets with splash; it is the root archetype bonus too
Multiplies every elemental hit
Weapon/Helm elemental roll — flat increased damage plus the debuff proc Shocking Focus applies more often
Righteous Fire deals 10% of max HP and Healing Flames regens a % of it — HP is offense and sustain here
